summary: Vehicle physics torque helper: computes the lateral torque output from an input force by multiplying the input by the stored lateral force coefficient and a fixed 0.01 scaling constant, then writes the product back into the torque output field. Unconditional single-expression body; runs on the per-frame tick.

operations.description: Compute the scaled lateral torque: multiply input force a2 by the lateral force coefficient read from this+0x44F4 and by the scaling constant 0.0099999998.
Store the computed product into the lateral torque output field this+0x453C (recalculated every frame; an external poke does not persist).
Void __thiscall; implicit return after the store.

unresolved: Global 0x0059E444 (flt_59E444) is reported as a read-only reference inside this function by static analysis, but the raw source shows only literal 0.0099999998; the exact role of the global (e.g. storage behind the scaling constant, or frame delta) is not deterministically tied.
Vehicle owner (which physics object holds the 0x44F4 / 0x453C fields) is unknown; the two callers are 00424080 and AIDriverRandomSelector (0042AE20).
Whether a2 is a raw force value or a pre-scaled input depends on the callers' contracts.
